description: This file contains test cases for gateway-related utility functions and constants used in the project, verifying their behavior with various profiles, versions, and default values.

methods.name: normalizeGatewayProfile
methods.description: Normalizes the gateway profile string, trimming whitespace and returning null for default or empty profiles.

methods.name: resolveGatewayLaunchAgentLabel
methods.description: Determines the launch agent label based on the profile, defaulting if none is set.

methods.name: resolveGatewaySystemdServiceName
methods.description: Generates the systemd service name based on the profile, defaulting if none is set.

methods.name: resolveGatewayWindowsTaskName
methods.description: Returns the Windows task scheduler name based on the profile, defaulting if none is set.

methods.name: resolveGatewayProfileSuffix
methods.description: Provides a suffix for profiles, with a hyphen for custom profiles and empty for default profiles.

methods.name: formatGatewayServiceDescription
methods.description: Formats the service description string, including profile and version info if provided.

methods.name: resolveGatewayServiceDescription
methods.description: Resolves the full service description string, prioritizing explicit override and falling back to environment variables.
